people.name: Sanjay Banga
people.role: Additional Director, CEO Designate, and CEO & Managing Director
people.bio: Mr. Sanjay Banga is the Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited and currently holds the position of President – Renewables of The Tata Power Company Limited. He previously served as President of the Transmission and Distribution businesses and CEO of Tata Power Delhi Distribution Limited. He has more than three decades of experience. He is an alumnus of the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra, and holds an MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies, University of Delhi.
